subject: prd/installer
statement: If an argument beginning with `-` occupies a positional slot, or an unknown flag is passed, on any `pyxis` verb, then the system shall refuse with a named usage error before performing any write or external operation
fit_criterion: misparse fixtures (flag-after-positional, unknown flag) on init/converge/doctor refuse with zero writes and zero external operations, in interactive and flag-only modes
